title: The craft hold has a clear bar, and the bench crafts x5, x10 or Max
why: His order 2026-10-15: "Hold to craft does not work correctly: it needs a clear 1-second bar" and "A way to craft multiples quickly (for example craft 10)". The old fill was 55% amber over an amber button, so a hold looked like nothing. Now a press turns the button into a dark track with a solid amber fill and light text, and it resets when the hold ends. Chips x1, x5, x10 and Max sit above the button when the stash holds at least two sets; one 1-second hold crafts that many, never more than the stash allows.
now: The craft hold fills a clear bar. Pick x5, x10 or Max on the bench to craft several with one hold.
